metadata.description: Mod Maker: find what you ask Claude again and again, and turn it into a mod. Plus 8 example mods and a virtual office.

plugins.name: office
plugins.description: A pixel-art office in a local web page: each Claude session gets a desk, walks to the filing cabinet when it reads, types when it edits, sends paper planes when it messages, and shows a live Done-by clock

plugins.name: mission-control
plugins.description: A live panel above your prompt: the plan as a stage bar, what Claude is doing in plain English, your asks ticked off, and a chime when it is done

plugins.name: mod-maker
plugins.description: /mod-audit, /mod-build, /mod-check and a habit spotter that offers to turn a repeat ask into a mod

plugins.name: safe-delete
plugins.description: Deletes Claude runs go to the Bin instead, with a receipt and /undo-delete

plugins.name: secrets-guard
plugins.description: Stops Claude reading .env and key files, masks API keys in command output, and lets you hand Claude a key through a pane without it ever seeing the value

plugins.name: open-loops
plugins.description: A pane listing every ask you make in a session, ticked off only with proof

plugins.name: show-it
plugins.description: Opens the newest page, image or video Claude made, without stealing focus

plugins.name: sessions-band
plugins.description: A band above the prompt listing your other open sessions, with an Ask button

plugins.name: pre-build-check
plugins.description: Re-reads your CLAUDE.md rules before any build, and keeps references to structure only

plugins.name: done-ping
plugins.description: A desktop notification with a sound when Claude finishes a long answer or may need your OK

plugins.name: plain-reply
plugins.description: Grades every reply for length, long sentences and jargon, and offers a one-click 'Say it simpler' draft when it goes over your bar

plugins.name: outbox
plugins.description: Holds every message Claude tries to send (WhatsApp, email, Slack) until you read it, see who it goes to, and press Send
